What was the average national income (in crores) for the years 1987 - 88, 1988 - 89 and 1989 - 90?
solution:
**Given:**

National Income for 1987 - 88 = Rs. 329.200 crores.

National Income for 1988 - 89 = Rs. 389.500 crores.

National Income for 1989 - 90 = Rs. 434.500 crores.

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of quantities / Number of quantities

**Calculation:**

Sum of National Income for the years 1987-88, 1988-89, and 1989-90 = Rs. 329.200 + Rs. 389.500 + Rs. 434.500

⇒ Sum = Rs. 1153.200 crores

Number of years = 3

Average National Income = Rs. 1153.200 crores / 3

Average National Income = Rs. 384.4 crores

**The average national income for the years 1987 - 88, 1988 - 89 and 1989 - 90 is Rs. 384.4 crores.**
